svg.text: What lscpu exposes: 32 vCPUs on both, but a different number of physical cores
Intel c7i.8xlarge: 16 physical cores x 2 SMT threads
L3 cache: 105 MiB (1 instance) L2: 16 x 2 MiB 1 socket, 1 NUMA node
AMD c7a.8xlarge: 32 physical cores x 1 thread
L3 cache: 128 MiB (4 instances) L2: 32 x 1 MiB 1 socket, 1 NUMA node
Intel: vCPU n and vCPU n+16 are two hardware threads of the SAME core (lscpu -e shows CPU 16 -> CORE 0, CPU 17 -> CORE 1, ...).
AMD: every vCPU is its own core (CPU n -> CORE n). Darker = first thread of each core, lighter = SMT sibling.
